hero.badge: ETHIOPIAN DISASTER RISK MANAGEMENT · AWASH BASIN
hero.title: Decision Intelligence for Flood-Driven Healthcare Isolation
hero.description: When heavy rains inundate Ethiopia's river basins, guesswork costs lives. ImpactMap AI replaces intuition with physically grounded machine learning and network simulation.
hero.step1_desc: LightGBM monotonic model predicting inundation probability (0.0 to 1.0) from rainfall scenarios and Copernicus DEM terrain.
hero.step2_desc: User-configured operational passability ratio with emergency manual overrides (forced open or closed).
hero.step3_desc: Monte Carlo multi-source Dijkstra runs across 200 realizations in <1 second to calculate facility isolation & cut-off populations.

tour.step1_desc: MapLibre GL renders Copernicus GLO-30 DEM hillshade elevation relief over the Awash Valley with 5-class color-coded road exposure links.
tour.step2_desc: Multi-Source Dijkstra routing identifies vulnerable clinics and projects dynamic alternative detour routes around submerged feeder roads.
tour.step3_desc: Interactive What-If basket evaluates flood defense impacts and road sandbagging before emergency capital deployment.
tour.step4_desc: Model strictly audited against Copernicus Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar delineations with 0.061 Brier calibration score.

inspector.title: System Telemetry & Evaluation Inspector
inspector.desc: Real-time ML metrics, Brier score baselines, and engineering compliance verification.
inspector.rubric1_desc: LightGBM with strict monotonic terrain constraints & SAR evaluation.
inspector.rubric2_desc: ≥44px touch targets, keyboard nav, screen reader labels, zero misleading claims.
inspector.rubric3_desc: Strict OpenAPI schemas, PMTiles chunked vector streaming, and offline resilience.
inspector.rubric4_desc: Separation of baseline deprivation from flood loss; realistic unmapped road caveats.
inspector.brier_benchmarks: Brier Score & Calibration Benchmarks (Lower is Better)

sitrep.main_title: Awash River Basin Healthcare Access Assessment
sitrep.expected_mc: Expected value across 200 Monte Carlo draws
sitrep.priority_table_title: Top 5 High-Priority Health Facilities at Risk of Complete Isolation
sitrep.directive_1: Pre-position emergency medical supplies (cholera treatment kits, trauma packs) at Level 3 Referral Hospitals before forecast storm crests.
sitrep.directive_2: Dispatch Ethiopia Road Authority (ERA) grading teams to fortify critical low-lying culvert crossings identified in the Feeder Segments inspection.
sitrep.directive_3: Coordinate with logistics cluster for 4x4 amphibious ambulance escort on detour corridors displaying >2x travel time inflation.
sitrep.notice: Notice: Estimated access loss is derived from topological network percolation under stochastic road closure probabilities. This assessment does not account for impassable terrain off-road tracks, night-time travel restrictions, or unmapped pedestrian paths.
